STATUTE READ, NAMES NOBODY. National Reserve Bank of Tonga (Amendment) Act 2014 on PacLII (pacliirms.paclii.org/to/legis/num_act/nrbota2014359.pdf) read in full. Section 54B(1) requires the external audit to be 'performed in accordance with the International Standards on Auditing by independent external auditors who shall be of good repute and have recognised international experience'; section 9A(1)(m) has the Board 'recommend the appointment of the external auditors of the Bank to the Minister'; section 54B(3) lets the Minister dismiss them; 54B(5)-(6) give them full access and require publication with the annual statements. No firm and no audit institution named - a generic 'external auditor' provision, so not a record. A search for NRBT annual report plus 'independent auditor' returned only PacLII gazettes, centralbanking.com abstracts and Matangi Tonga profit stories, none naming a firm.
